name: Alpengasthof Sonnenstein
kurzbeschreibung:
**Sunshine Alpine Lodge Sonnenstein in Mieders**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, the **Alpengasthof Sonnenstein** in **Mieders** offers a cozy retreat with breathtaking mountain views. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming alpine inn combines rustic warmth with modern comforts.

Indulge in hearty **Tirol** dishes like creamy **Käsespätzle**, tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** served with fresh fruit compote. Pair your meal with a crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of local **Graubündner Wein** from neighboring **Graubünden**.

After a satisfying lunch or dinner, relax by the crackling fireplace or take a stroll through the lush meadows surrounding the lodge. In winter, enjoy snowshoeing or cross-country skiing right from your doorstep, while summer invites hiking and mountain biking along scenic trails.

The **Sonnenstein** also welcomes families, with a play area for children and spacious rooms offering stunning panoramic views of the **Karwendel** and **Zillertal** valleys. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, this alpine gem promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.
